newsitem.title: USA: Clear Channel files to offer 10 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Clear Channel files to offer 10 mln shares.

text.p: Clear Channel Communications Inc on Friday filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 10 million common shares.
The company said it would sell 4,093,790 shares and certain shareholders would sell 5,906,210 shares.

Underwriters for the offering are Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston, Furman Selz, Goldman Sachs & Co, Lehman Brothers, Montgomery Securities and Salomon Brothers. They have an overallotment option of up to 614,068 shares.
The San Antonio-based diversified media company said it would use the proceeds to repay outstanding debt under a credit facility.
After the offering, the company will have 88 million shares outstanding, according to the SEC filing.
